cards.ex: Despite her qualifications, she kept hitting the glass ceiling at her company.
cards.exUz: Malakasiga qaramay, u kompaniyasida shisha shiftga urilaverdi.
cards.uzDef: Ayollar yoki ozchiliklar yuqori lavozimlarga ko'tarilishiga to'sqinlik qiladigan yashirin to'siq.

cards.ex: The government is trying to bridge the digital divide by providing internet access to rural areas.
cards.exUz: Hukumat qishloq joylariga internet ulanishini ta'minlab, raqamli tafovutni bartaraf etishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Aholining kompyuter va internetdan foydalanish imkoniyatidagi farqi.

cards.ex: Ageism in the workplace can prevent older workers from finding new jobs.
cards.exUz: Ish joyida yoshga nisbatan kamsitish keksa ishchilarni yangi ish topishiga to'sqinlik qilishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ish joyida yoshga qarab kamsitish, ayniqsa keksa odamlarga nisbatan.

cards.ex: Many elderly people are living in fuel poverty during the winter months.
cards.exUz: Ko'p qariyalar qish oylarida yoqilg'i qashshoqligida yashaydilar.
cards.uzDef: Uyini isitish uchun yetarli yoqilg'i sotib olishga puli yetmaydigan holat.

cards.ex: Residents of the food desert have limited access to fresh fruits and vegetables.
cards.exUz: Oziq-ovqat cho'lida yashovchilarning yangi meva va sabzavotlarga kirish imkoniyati cheklangan.
cards.uzDef: Sog'lom va arzon oziq-ovqat mahsulotlari topish qiyin bo'lgan hudud.

cards.ex: Income inequality is a growing concern in many developed countries.
cards.exUz: Daromad tengsizligi ko'plab rivojlangan mamlakatlarda ortib borayotgan muammo.
cards.uzDef: Aholining turli qatlamlari daromadlaridagi katta farq.

cards.ex: The city needs to build more affordable housing to address the housing crisis.
cards.exUz: Shahar uy-joy inqirozini hal qilish uchun ko'proq arzon uy-joy qurishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'rtacha daromadli odamlar uchun sotib olishga qulay bo'lgan uy-joy.

cards.ex: Systemic racism affects every aspect of life, from education to employment.
cards.exUz: Tizimli irqchilik hayotning har bir jabhasiga, ta'limdan tortib ish bilan ta'minlashgacha ta'sir qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatning tuzilmalarida mavjud bo'lgan irqchilik.

cards.ex: The protests were sparked by recent cases of police brutality.
cards.exUz: Noroziliklar yaqinda sodir bo'lgan politsiya zo'ravonligi holatlari tufayli kelib chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Politsiyaning keraksiz yoki haddan tashqari kuch ishlatishi.

cards.ex: The community was shocked by the hate crime committed against the mosque.
cards.exUz: Jamoatchilik masjidga qarshi sodir etilgan nafrat jinoyatidan hayratda qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Qurbonning irqi, dini yoki boshqa xususiyatlariga asoslangan jinoyat.

cards.ex: The social safety net provides assistance to the unemployed and the disabled.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy himoya tarmog'i ishsizlarga va nogironlarga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Yordamga muhtoj odamlarga yordam beradigan dasturlar tizimi.

cards.ex: Children from broken homes may face more challenges in life.
cards.exUz: Buzilgan oilalardan chiqqan bolalar hayotda ko'proq qiyinchiliklarga duch kelishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ota-onalari ajrashgan yoki alohida yashaydigan oilalar.

cards.ex: Drug abuse can have devastating consequences for individuals and communities.
cards.exUz: Giyohvandlik shaxslar va jamiyatlar uchun halokatli oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Narkotik moddalarni suiiste'mol qilish yoki ularga qaram bo'lib qolish.

cards.ex: Youth unemployment is a major challenge in many countries.
cards.exUz: Yoshlar ishsizligi ko'plab mamlakatlarda asosiy muammo hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Yoshlarning ish bilan ta'minlanmaganlik darajasi.

cards.ex: The government's austerity measures have led to cuts in public services.
cards.exUz: Hukumatning tejamkorlik choralari davlat xizmatlarining qisqarishiga olib keldi.
cards.uzDef: Davlat xarajatlarini kamaytirish siyosati.

cards.ex: The elderly and children are considered vulnerable populations during a crisis.
cards.exUz: Qariyalar va bolalar inqiroz paytida himoyasiz aholi hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Himoyaga muhtoj bo'lgan aholi guruhlari.

cards.ex: Breaking the cycle of poverty requires comprehensive social and economic reforms.
cards.exUz: Qashshoqlik davrasini buzish keng qamrovli ijtimoiy va iqtisodiy islohotlarni talab qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Qashshoqlikdan chiqish qiyin bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: We need to support marginalized groups and ensure they have equal opportunities.
cards.exUz: Biz cheklangan guruhlarni qo'llab-quvvatlashimiz va ularga teng imkoniyatlar yaratishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatda chetlashtirilgan yoki kamsitilgan guruhlar.

cards.ex: Social exclusion can lead to feelings of isolation and despair.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy chetlashtirish izolyatsiya va umidsizlik tuyg'ulariga olib kelishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatdan chetlashtirish yoki ajratish holati.

cards.ex: Programs are needed to support underprivileged children and help them succeed.
cards.exUz: Imtiyozsiz bolalarni qo'llab-quvvatlash va ularga muvaffaqiyat qozonishga yordam berish uchun dasturlar kerak.
cards.uzDef: Imkoniyatlari cheklangan yoki kambag'al oilalardagi bolalar.

cards.ex: Closing the gender pay gap is crucial for achieving gender equality.
cards.exUz: Gender ish haqi tafovutini bartaraf etish gender tengligiga erishish uchun juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Erkaklar va ayollar o'rtasidagi ish haqi farqi.

cards.ex: Xenophobia can lead to discrimination and violence against immigrants.
cards.exUz: Ksenofobiya immigrantlarga nisbatan kamsitish va zo'ravonlikka olib kelishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Chet elliklarga nisbatan qo'rquv yoki nafrat.

cards.ex: The lack of representation in politics is a serious problem.
cards.exUz: Siyosatda vakillikning yetishmasligi jiddiy muammo.
cards.uzDef: Muayyan guruhlarning etarli darajada vakili bo'lmasligi.

cards.ex: Wage stagnation has made it difficult for many families to make ends meet.
cards.exUz: Ish haqining turg'unligi ko'plab oilalarga kun kechirishni qiyinlashtirdi.
cards.uzDef: Ish haqining o'smay qolishi yoki sekin o'sishi.

cards.ex: Zero-hour contracts can lead to financial insecurity for workers.
cards.exUz: Nol soatli shartnomalar ishchilar uchun moliyaviy beqarorlikka olib kelishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ish beruvchi ish soatlarini kafolatlamaydigan shartnomalar.

cards.ex: Affordable childcare is essential for working parents.
cards.exUz: Arzon bolalar parvarishi ishlaydigan ota-onalar uchun muhim.
cards.uzDef: Ota-onalar uchun qulay narxdagi bolalar parvarishi.

cards.ex: It's hard to get by on minimum wage these days.
cards.exUz: Bugungi kunda minimal ish haqi bilan kun kechirish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchilik bilan yashash yoki pul topish.

cards.ex: People would be better off if they had access to healthcare.
cards.exUz: Odamlar tibbiy xizmatga ega bo'lsalar, yaxshiroq ahvolda bo'lishardi.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshiroq sharoitda yoki ahvolda bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Children from disadvantaged backgrounds are more likely to fall behind in school.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy jihatdan nochor ahvoldagi bolalar maktabda ortda qolish ehtimoli ko'proq.
cards.uzDef: Rivojlanishdan yoki qolganlardan ortda qolmoq.

cards.ex: With the right policies, we can turn things around and create a fairer society.
cards.exUz: To'g'ri siyosat bilan biz vaziyatni o'zgartirib, adolatliroq jamiyat yaratishimiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni yaxshi tomonga o'zgartirmoq.
